quote.author: Adam Aaronson
quote.text:
The Sixers have an injury report for tomorrow’s game @ New York:

Dean Wade – ankle – QUESTIONABLE

Anfernee Simons – hamstring – QUESTIONABLE

Adem Bona – foot – QUESTIONABLE

Dominick Barlow – back – OUT

Tacko Fall – quad – OUT

Ariel Hukporti – Achilles – OUT

items.title: With Ben Simmons now out with a torn Achilles injury, that makes two already for the season with Ariel Hukporti rupturing his early this month. Horrible to see, especially as the season hasn't even started. Seems like another season with possibly even more players having the same injury.
items.author: WinterStarlightZone
items.body_excerpt: Hoping they both make full recoveries and are able to come back next season if they so desire. These injuries are so devastating and hoping no more occur the remainder of this season. EDIT: OKC's Otega Oweh also ruptured his right Achilles tendon in his preseason game against…
